name: kicker-overline-pair
title: Kicker Overline Pair
description: The magazine pairing: a tracked-out uppercase kicker over a display headline, locked to a shared baseline grid with an optically-weighted rule between them — one component that enforces the editorial relationship.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Swiss
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Airy
Shape: Sharp
Motion: None
Typography: Grotesk
Color: Monochrome

## Rules

- Static: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
